AllowedUsers.title: AllowedUsers
AllowedUsers.description: Authorized emails permitted to enter the application with roles (admin or viewer)

emails.description: List of authorized email addresses in lowercase

admins.description: List of admin email addresses in lowercase

roles.description: Mapping from lowercase email to role (admin or viewer)

updatedBy.description: Email of user who made the update

SettingConfig.title: SettingConfig
SettingConfig.description: Application packing charge, inbound freight, and marketplace customer-return percentages

packing_per_dispatched_unit.description: Packing charge per dispatched unit in INR (default 6)

inbound_freight_per_purchased_unit.description: Inbound freight per purchased unit in INR (default 5)

updatedBy.description: User email who updated the settings

SettingAudit.title: SettingAudit
SettingAudit.description: Audit log record for changes made to application settings

setting_key.description: Name or key of the setting modified

user_email.description: Email of user who made the change

CostMasterItem.title: CostMasterItem
CostMasterItem.description: Cost master record with sku_code, sku_name, weight_grams, mfg_cost, active, and effective_from

mfg_cost.description: Manufacturing or base procurement cost in INR

active.description: Active status of SKU (soft delete when false)

createdBy.description: User who created this cost record

OpeningStockItem.title: OpeningStockItem
OpeningStockItem.description: Per SKU baseline opening stock quantity and manufacturing rate as of 2026-04-01

mfg_rate.description: Manufacturing or base unit rate in INR

effective_from.description: Effective date of opening stock baseline (default 2026-04-01)

createdBy.description: Email of user who created this opening stock row

PurchaseItem.title: PurchaseItem
PurchaseItem.description: Procurement purchase inward record with landed rate, bill number, supplier, and void flag

mfg_rate.description: Unit manufacturing or purchase rate in INR

landed_rate.description: Unit landed rate (mfg_rate + inbound_freight at time of entry)

upload_id.description: Reference ID to purchase_uploads batch or 'manual'

void.description: Soft void flag: rows are never deleted, void rows excluded from cost averages

createdBy.description: Email of user who recorded this purchase

PurchaseUpload.title: PurchaseUpload
PurchaseUpload.description: Audit record of purchase spreadsheet file uploads

file_name.description: Original name of the uploaded file

user.description: User email who performed the upload

accepted_count.description: Count of valid purchase rows imported

/allowedUsers/{docId}.description: List of authorized user emails and roles (admin or viewer)

/settings/{docId}.description: Application settings configuration and create-only audit log entries

/cost_master/{itemId}.description: Effective-dated cost master rows with weight_grams, mfg_cost, and active status

/opening_stock/{docId}.description: Per-SKU create-only opening stock records with effective_from

/purchases/{docId}.description: Purchase line items with landed_rate, upload_id, and admin void status

/purchase_uploads/{docId}.description: Audit log of purchase spreadsheet file uploads with accepted, rejected, and skipped counts
